title: GameObject 'Gear' does not reference component MonoBehaviour. Fixing.
notes: Fix 2026-10-26 by claude (cb51edde09): 60000fe9ee (palette pass) took KitRimMesh/KitAmbient out of the GameObjects' component lists but left the component documents in Menu_Main.unity, so Unity re-attached them on every load. The orphaned documents are deleted (also in ConnectingPanel.prefab and Maelstrom.unity). Pull Ys-bleeding-edge.
